notes:
Summary: mid-market CCaaS provider focused on reducing live-agent load via aggressive deflection. Primary ask = high-volume, low-cost text-deflection with decent accuracy so NPS doesn't drop.

Key constraints / asks:
- Volume: ~50k incoming chat threads/day, peak concurrency ~1.2k active sessions, ~4k deflection checks/minute during marketing spikes.
- Latency targets: median deflection decision <200ms; p95 <500ms under normal ops, acceptable up to 800ms in extreme spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: target 60% lower per-conversation cost vs current OpenAI spend; internal goal = <$75k ARR unit economics for global deflection service (targets get refined in POC).
- Model profile: prefer open/quantizable models (Llama family or compatible), will evaluate int8/int4 quantization; want model variants for routing (primary high-accuracy, fallback fast-quantized).
- Runtime features required: batching, prefix/KV caching for repeated customer prompts, automatic small-model fallback for cost spikes, deterministic token accounting for billing reconciliation.
- Integration: Zendesk + Amazon Connect + internal routing. Tool-calling: need structured outputs for automated ticket triage and ephemeral tool calls into their workflows.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, SOC2 required, KMS integration for keys, audit logs, and retention controls. Data residency discussion for EU customers.

POC scope & success metrics:
- 2-week POC on Dedicated pool. Week 1 = perf baseline with unquantized model; Week 2 = quantized model + batching to hit target cost-per-deflection.
- Acceptance: match baseline accuracy within 4% absolute for top-1 deflection recommendation, reduce per-conversation inference cost by >=45% (goal >=60%). p95 latency within agreed SLOs during 2x synthetic spike.

Sales touches & quotes:
- Quote sent for 3-month trial Dedicated capacity + Optimize consult. Rough ARR projection $120k-$200k if POC successful.

Rep notes / paraphrase from calls:
- "If we can get reliable deflection at 1/3 the cost, we hit our CAC payback goal" — VP Product.
- Engineering: concerned about quantization regressions on short chat prompts; wants sample outputs before procurement.

Open items:

- Zendesk app permission model / certification timeline.
- Procurement: legal review window estimated 4-6 weeks after POC sign-off.
